Middleware wraps a handler. It runs before the handler, can change the request, and runs again after the handler returns, so it can change the response too. Middleware registered on a path applies to every route below that path. Middleware registered without a path applies to every route of the app. The order of registration is the order in which middleware runs, outermost first. A middleware that does not call next ends the request there, which is how an authentication middleware rejects a request. Errors thrown by a handler reach the middleware that wraps it, which may turn them into a response.
